messages:
maya: Quick sync — found several audit logging coverage gaps across services (API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime). I uploaded a draft spreadsheet with per-service gaps and suggested priorities: https://drive.redwood/example. Need triage + owners. Top asks: 1) schema changes for customer-facing events (actor_role, auth_method, kms_key_alias), 2) server-side validation + e2e test harness for exported events, 3) backlog tickets assigned. Meeting in 30? :calendar:
samir: +1. From infra side: api-gateway currently only enforces required fields for internal ingestion, not public schema. We should add a validation layer (schema registry) upfront so bad events don't propagate. I'll sketch a short RFC and a PR for enforcement.
hugo: FYI billing reported we don't emit `billing.plan.update` reliably for webhook exports — dedupe logic collapsed some updates. Also runtime isn't attaching kms info for encrypted artifacts.
lisa: Agree on schema enforcement. Also we need a versioning plan and a deprecation path so we can add fields safely. Proposal: add `event_schema_version` and namespace public fields under `public`. Example event (customer-facing): ```json
{
  "event_type":"user.login",
  "event_schema_version":"v2",
  "actor":{ "id":"u-123", "role":"admin" },
  "auth_method":"sso",
  "resource":{ "type":"instance", "id":"i-9" },
  "public":{ "kms_key_alias":"redwood-prod-01" }
}```
maya: Good call on namespacing — avoids leaking ARNs/PII. For customer-facing exports we must mask internal IDs and surface aliases only. Also update OpenAPI for the console export endpoint and docs.
samir: Plan from infra: (a) add schema registry entry v2 with fields: `actor_role`, `auth_method`, `event_schema_version`, `public.kms_key_alias`; (b) validation middleware in api-gateway rejecting non-conformant events; (c) integration tests that replay events through gateway and assert exported payload. Draft timeline: PRs by EOD Thu for api-gateway, tests added to eng-runtime CI next week.
oncall-ops: audit-bot alert: `alert: billing.plan.update not emitted for customer acme-corp in last 7d` — created incident INC-9876.
hugo: Taking INC-9876. Root cause: billing worker retry/dedupe collapsed multiple updates into one; patch will attach `request_id` and `sequence_id` to billing payload to avoid collapsing. Quick patch out today, follow-up change to export pipeline to include request_id in public namespace.
lisa: For validation harness, propose a small script that posts synthetic events and then polls the export S3 bucket/console export endpoint to validate fields and absence of internal fields. Example check in shell: ```bash
# post synthetic event
curl -X POST $GATEWAY/events -d @synthetic.json 
# poll export and assert schema
python -c "import json,sys; e=json.load(open('export.json')); assert 'arn:' not in json.dumps(e) and e['event_schema_version']=='v2'"
```
This becomes an e2e job `ci/audit-e2e.sh`.
maya: OK splitting backlog responsibilities for sprint planning: api-gateway validation + schema registry (samir); auth changes to ensure `auth_method` present (lisa); console export masking + OpenAPI updates (maya); billing dedupe fix + request_id (hugo); runtime team to add `actor_role` for KV/cache operations that are surfaced to customers (samir + runtime). I'll create GH issues, link to spreadsheet, and move highest-priority items into the sprint backlog. Target: ship schema v2 + audit-e2e tests within 2 sprints.
samir: Will create the schema PR today and add a lightweight migration plan (emit both v1 and v2 while consumers update). :thumbsup:
audit-bot: Created sandbox export bucket `audit-export-sbx-17798` for e2e tests and added write ACL for eng-security CI.
maya: Thanks — assigning tickets and will follow up after stand. If anyone hits blockers creating PRs, ping me or drop the diff in this thread. :eyes:
oncall-ops: Noted. Will monitor INC-9876 and escalate if new regressions appear.
